card.name: Where a text says what it stresses
card.fires_on: The word emphasize/emphasizes after a subject such as a diet, principles or a program. It also fires on linking words or commas where the next word could be "emphasizing" or a list of core values.

modes.label: Emphasize verbs
modes.description: The verb emphasize or emphasizes is itself marked, after a subject that stresses certain ideas.

modes.description: A small linking word or comma follows a described approach and leads into the principles it stresses.

card.writes: It promotes emphasis words such as emphasize and emphasizing, in English and Chinese.
